pipeline.evidence: R1 re-test: blur-first order reconstructs all 5/5 support pairs pixel-identically (0 differing pixels, max_abs_diff=0, PSNR=inf, CI 10/10); removing this step drops pair0 to 32.89 dB; reversing to gamma-first drops to 41.87 dB; blur_lens:1 first reaches only 47.81 dB. blur sev1 is real but spectrally masked by the gamma darkening (spectral_slope_ratio 0.92-1.06).

R1 re-fit on all 5 pairs: median-V transfer in bins 0.50-0.95 implies gamma 3.50-3.73 == library sev5 gamma 3.5; per-bin median V shift is non-constant (-109..-45), ruling out additive brightness_darken_shfit (tested: 18.85 dB). Mean shift -49.6..-70.1; exact reconstruction with HSV:5 on 5/5 pairs.

alternatives.note: R1-verified best cross-family alternative (lens-first order). Spectrally indistinguishable from gaussian sev1 per SKILL C3 but NOT pixel-identical (47.81 dB vs inf), so it is a backup only; gap is infinite, do not use for training.

analysis.psnr_detail: inf dB (pixel-perfect: 0 differing pixels, max_abs_diff=0 on all 5 support pairs; 'inf' not JSON-representable, hence null)
analysis.psnr_gap: inf (primary exact on 5/5 pairs; runner-up R1-verified blur_lens:1 at 47.81 dB)

evidence.exact_reconstruction: add_distortion(clean_i,1,'blur_gaussian') then add_distortion(.,5,'brightness_darken_gamma_HSV') == degraded_i for i=0..4 (R1 independent re-run; identical=True, max_abs_diff=0)
evidence.gamma_fit_R1: median V_target vs V_clean bins 0.50-0.95 imply gamma 3.50-3.73 on all 5 pairs == library sev5 gamma 3.5 (pair2 >0.90 bins 4.12-4.14 are clipping-contaminated)
evidence.gamma_vs_brightness_R1: additive V shift per intensity bin is non-constant (-109..-45), incompatible with any single-severity additive shift; direct test brightness_darken_shfit_HSV:5 gives 18.85 dB (CI 2/10)
evidence.noise: ruled out: wavelet sigma 0.37-1.11 (<2) on 5/5 pairs; PSNR mode valid
evidence.compression: ruled out: block_boundary 0.9902-1.0166 (<1.1) on 5/5 pairs; pair3 unique_G=194 is a borderline compression rule hit but exact 0-residual reconstruction without any compression step proves it is a uint8+gamma+blur artifact, not JPEG
evidence.saturation: false positive: target HSV S mean 121.4 > clean 100.7; V-gamma raises S; 0 residual without a saturation step
evidence.contrast: false positive: variance_ratio 0.57-1.37 is clipping-confounded (clipped_fraction 4.2-46.2%); after gamma simulation variance matches exactly (pixel-identical)
evidence.order: blur before gamma: reverse order gives 41.87 dB vs inf for blur-first
